Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original

delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address Arang DIst Raipur Jagdalpur Raipur Budhapara Saraipali Tilda . 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 4. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Features /Requirements a) Every Gold Safe Shall be provided with a permanent identification metalic plates as per applicable BIS st andard should be fixed riveting/welding. The plate shall be engraved not printed with the following:- i manufacturers name/trademark ii BIS Certifications marks iii Safe models/type and class (AA) IV Standard reference V Year of manufacture VI Unique Serial Number VII Engraving Shall be legible, indelible and tamper evident VIII Affixing QR Code :- QR Code must be affixed by OEM on each Gold safe before dispatching it to the ba nk with having above mentioned information , securely to prevent any tempering) B) OEM Has to provide Undertaking for Declaration of Gold Safe specifications as per type tested Gold Safe

for BIS Certifications on OEM's letter Head as per Annexure Enclosed. C) All Wires in Gold Safe must be properly insulated. D) Vibrations Sensor must be installed inside the safe door appropriately. E) Each Drawer must be provide with 02 removable verticals partitions. F) The biometric lock should have minimum battery lock of 1 years. The autodialled systems should be ca pable of sending required/applicable call/SMS Alerts for duress events during working hours. G) The intrusion related SMS/Call alerts should be generated during non-working hours any holidays, inclu ding activations of siren/fogging system as applicable during any incident. H) Fogging System must operate on standalone battery having optimum useful life for operating the foggi ng system at least twice successfully during attempts/incidents. I) The Biometric Devices with lock/sensors/fogging Device/Auto Dialler much have the certifications by BIS/ IEC/CE/FCC/UL/any other applicable certifications. J) OEM indemnity bond (to ensure testing on cost sharing Basis/Recovery of compensation cost on failure o f re-tested Gold Safe during testing) K) Bank has right to go random testing of Gold Safe if needed necessary. L) OEM Indemnity bond (to ensure testing on cost sharing basis/Recovery of compensation cost of failure o f re tested Gold safe during testing) M)All Gold Safes and Keys locks should meet the latest Bureau of Indian Standard (BIS) Additional Mandatory Biometric Lock features: a) Duress Feature to be finger based (a third finger biometri c to be stored in the system to activate duress alarm). A Call and message will be sent to minimum 8 pre-s tored numbers silently (Such alerts should go to staff other than Branch Staff). b) Tamper proof with Battery life of minimum 1 year. Alert to be generated continuously when the battery attains the residual capacity of 30%(approx.), a message will be sent to minimum 8 pre-store numbers ap art from physical LED alert. c) Tamper Proof Lock: Vibration Sensor to be installed with the Lock so as to raise an alarm if tampering is done on the Lock (A call and message will be sent to minimum 8 pre-stored numbers). Sound alert also be generated. d) Dual Biometric Authentication-At any point of time only two authorized custodians are to be permitted t o operate Biometric Lock. e) Biometric Lock with electronic display / digital display facility. f) Minimum 15 User access - should support biometric access for minimum 15 registered users and 45 fin ger biometric access enrolment. g) Electronic Display- For monitoring the operations on screen & displaying regular alerts & battery life. h) Door open indication- Buzzer alerts the user if door remains open beyond the specified time with provisi on for modifying the time & sound range. i) Door not locked indication- if the door is closed but not locked along with key, door not locked indication should be displayed on the screen. These details should be available in event logs. j) Door auto lock-Biometric lock gets automatically locked once the door is locked and handle is rotated.

k) Dual mode control with the role of administrators/manager with enabling & disabling access & the role of users for regular operations. l) Minimum 1000 Event Audit Logs -Should maintain detailed log of minimum 1000 latest access to the eve nts, such as, biometric details for opening Gold Safe with date & time stamped and details of closure of gol d safe like rotation of handle for monitoring and audit purpose along with wire audit download functionality and option for only downloading the log but not uploading. Log count should be displayed on the screen. m) For new gold safe, Biometric facilities should be inbuilt, factory modulated safes and no retrofitting bio metric at branches is allowed on new gold safe. o) Log analysis software to be provided by the vendor supplying Gold Safes. p) Fail-Secure Condition- Gold Safe cannot be opened, if Biometric lock fails or battery is dead (It should no t be a Fail-Safe Condition). r) Biometric Lock’s Battery must be securely fitted with in a pre-fabricated casing r) Biometric lock system should have Comprehensive Warranty for 1 years with a Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (CA MC) for a period of 04 years (Certificate be issued from OEM/Authorized Dealer with MAF). s) OEM/its Autho rized Dealer must provide maintenance support throughout its useful life (Certificate be issued from OEM/ Authorized Dealer with MAF). .
